auth_policy_facts_from_actual_sources: Claim policy for these QR POSTs is Refused, but validated_claim_session and expire_claim_presence precede that refusal. Signed revoked/expired-row claims therefore exercise actual cleanup and 401; valid claims retain 403 with unchanged presence and no DML.

Already-quarantined QR HTTP is rejected by the first deployment recovery middleware with deployment_quarantined 503. A real NORMAL-to-QUARANTINED transition after that outer check exercises the actual JWT recovery-principal 401 inside retained P.
must_change_password is refused by IsActiveStaff after valid native authentication updates last_used_at; that one global metadata UPDATE is asserted separately and no QR domain write is allowed.

tradeoffs: AST literal parameter products are authoring evidence, not pytest collection, execution, or a passing count. Root must collect/run the recorded command.

All patches change only a concrete misconfiguration value. No SourceLock, role, auth, permission, gate primitive or service admission guard is mocked. The inner observer middleware is inserted via settings and retains every production middleware in its original order.

Persisted native fixtures follow the existing device helper protocol and call the real token issuer to create refresh-family/token rows; the trusted fixture adds staff_api like the frozen staff JWT helper. No live attestation provider or login exchange is claimed.

P is discovered from fresh current-database pg_locks rows, then pg_stat_clear_snapshot precedes exact-PID activity inspection. Full lock metadata, raw backend SQL, worker SQL/params/PID, transaction continuity and exact exclusive blocking edges are recorded as JUnit properties.

P proof uses real successful execute results and event checkpoints at dispatch entry, auth UPDATE, real AuditLog INSERT and delegated response tail. Event waits are watchdogs only; exclusive lock exclusion is proven by pg_blocking_pids and ungranted exclusive pg_locks, without sleep-based winners or DB timeouts.

The Worker execute wrapper remains outside the SQL checkpoint observer, so its completed flag can still be false during the inner pause. The probe separately records completed=True only after the actual execute returns, with the raw backend PID; no attempted statement is represented as completed.

Auth refusal snapshots cover whole QR/domain/audit rows plus whole user, membership, grant, family, registration, claim and presence rows. Expected global auth/presence metadata writes are asserted separately from QR domain state.

Direct missing-P calls test typed SourceMigrationGateUnavailable and the real process_exception translator without claiming a bare DRF callback installs Django middleware. Full HTTP declaration drift and post-P late drift exercise actual middleware 503 translation.

No new permissions, scope expansion, fixtures in frozen directories, API/schema generation, registry/guard edits, staging or commits. Existing 25-scope/two-reversed/N-lifetime/four-423 matrices are referenced and combined, not recopied.

Three unrelated files changed concurrently outside this author scope; start/current hashes are retained. Approved three Stage 2 sources and all frozen QR suites/helpers stayed unchanged during this authoring turn.
